candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record supports IART with variable AV block in a Fontan patient: irregularly irregular rhythm with grouped beating, P waves at 440 ms cycle length (atrial rate ~136 bpm) with 2:1 or variable conduction, and adenosine revealing continued atrial tachycardia at 220 ms cycle length with transient heart block. 'Narrow complex SVT' is the broad parent class but does not specify IART as the mechanism, the variable AV block as a defining feature, or the Fontan/congenital substrate. These are required components of the benchmark reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: SVT narrow complex is the parent category; missing the specific subtype (IART), the structural/Fontan-related etiology, and the variable AV block component

case_quality_flags: Adenosine response (transient AV block with continuation of atrial tachycardia at 220 ms cycle length) is pathognomonic for IART/atrial flutter rather than AVNRT or AVRT, strongly anchoring the reference diagnosis.
